title: Deliver Wood to Bennwell Sawmill
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Wood** delivered to **Bennwell Sawmill** (industry id 2, near tile 17,14).

A likely supplier is **Bennwell Forest** (industry id 3, near tile 7,29); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **350 units** within the horizon.

**Promise:** within the first 30 game-days, commit to a delivery quantity with `rh promise quantity=N` (the last promise before the deadline counts; max 1,040). You are paid for min(delivered, promised) and fined for any shortfall, so promise what you can really deliver: over- and under-promising both cost you.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
